name: H00_crow_entering_then_leaving_without_dying_mills_once
note: Crow of Dark Tidings: the second trigger is for dying only (CR 700.4: a creature that is put into a graveyard from the battlefield dies). It enters (mill two), then is returned to its owner's hand: nothing dies, so the library loses only the two cards of the enters trigger. It can then enter again and mill two more.
